title: William Barr interviews Epstein's cellmate, who later dies

tellings.quote:
Donald Bar's son is a guy named William
Bar, the attorney general under Trump,
who personally visited Epstein's jail
cell after he died to interview his last
known cellmate, Ephra Stone Reyes, who
apparently expressed skepticism around
Epstein's suicide.

plain: After Jeffrey Epstein died in his New York jail cell in 2019, William Barr, then Trump's attorney general, personally went to the cell to interview Epstein's last known cellmate, Efrain Reyes, who reportedly doubted that Epstein killed himself. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and links it to Barr's father, Donald Barr, in an episode about Epstein and a supposed global cabal. The point is that the official account of suicide was questioned even by someone close to the scene.
